sens_en: to turn over, to leaf through, to cross
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche 番, écrit 釆 sur 田, qui se lit fān et donne le son. À droite deux 习, qui ensemble ont le tracé de 羽, les ailes. Des ailes qui battent et se retournent : retourner, feuilleter, franchir.
origine_en: As a memory aid: on the left is 番, written 釆 over 田, read fān, which gives the sound. On the right are two 习, which together have the shape of 羽, wings. Wings that flap and flip over: to turn over, to leaf through, to cross.

phrase.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shū fān dào dì shí yè.
phrase.fr: Ouvrez le livre à la page dix.
